args.title: Fix rowShape error from multiple trailing blank lines in parser
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In parseStatement, only one trailing empty string is popped after splitting on \n, so a file with extra blank lines after the last data row still has a blank entry in `lines`, which fails header-length validation and throws errors.rowShape. Change the logic to strip all trailing blank lines (or skip empty lines in the data-row loop) instead of popping just one.
